**Re: Senior Test Engineer**

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Test Engineer position with MAX at Tabcorp. With over 19 years of experience in quality engineering, end-to-end test automation, and release leadership across complex enterprise and payment environments, I am eager to contribute to the quality, reliability, and deployment readiness of your technology delivery initiatives.

My hands-on technical experience aligns directly with your team’s requirements. At Wpay (Woolworths Group), I formulated comprehensive test strategies and developed end-to-end automation solutions, including a complete Playwright automation suite. My core technical profile includes working knowledge of Playwright, TypeScript, and API automation, paired with extensive expertise in test case design, quality traceability, and defect management using tools such as JIRA and Zephyr across integration, regression, and acceptance testing phases.

In addition to hands-on automation and manual execution, I bring a strong background in test coordination and stakeholder collaboration. As QA Lead at Avant Mutual, I directed cross-functional release cycles, led alignment meetings, and governed daily defect triage sessions with development and business leads to enforce rigorous quality gates. Furthermore, my background fulfilling dual BA/QA requirements ownership allows me to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clear traceability and readiness across all deliverables.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my automation experience with Playwright, quality strategy execution, and background in release governance can add immediate value to Tabcorp. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
